"EX Styles":
"EX Styles are a system for strengthening your character by equipping one of several Styles.

You can equip a Style at the Class Counter."

"EXP earned by your Main Class is also awarded to your currently-equipped Style.
Once a Style earns enough EXP, its Level increases, which awards you with Style Skill Points.

You can use these Skill Points to learn Style Skills by going to the Class Counter and selecting Learn EX Style Skills.
※You may reallocate your Style Skill Points as many times as you like."

"Learning specific Style Skills will unlock a new action called After Blast.

After Blast can be triggered by selecting the Photon Blast action from your Palette after having already used a Photon Blast. Your Photon Blast action's icon will change when After Blast is available."
